body.estimand_functional: \(\Omega_{\mathrm{pop}}=\sum_{k=-2r}^{2r}\{\mathbb E_P[Z_0^{(1)}Z_k^{(2)}]-\tau_{\mathrm P}^2\}\), with the mean-centered test \(\phi_{n,\alpha}=\mathbf 1\{\widehat\Omega_n^{12}>t_n(\alpha)\}\); the auxiliary lag-\((2r+1)\) statistic satisfies \(\mathbb E_P[\widehat\Omega_n^{\mathrm u}]=\Omega_{\mathrm{pop}}\), and in the canonical score-vector experiment \(s_{n,\alpha,\beta}^{\mathrm{score}}=\Theta(n^{-1/2})\) for fixed \(r,B,\varepsilon,\alpha,\beta\), \(p=1/2\), and \(\alpha+\beta<1\).

sampling_model.design: Two conditionally independent Bernoulli assignment waves with known probability \(p\) are run on the same finite interval \(\Lambda_n\), with a prespecified washout and a fixed-width interior buffer.
sampling_model.units: One realization of a stationary radius-\(r\) innovation network on \(\mathbb Z\), observed through \(\Lambda_n=\{1,\ldots,n\}\) and analyzed on \(I_n\).
sampling_model.treatment: Binary assignments \(D_i^{(1)}\) and \(D_i^{(2)}\) enter the same local exposure maps and no-carryover potential-outcome schedule.
sampling_model.overlap: Both focal exposures have conditional probability at least \(\varepsilon\) in each wave.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The propensities are known from the design. The statistic estimates only the two wave means \(\widehat\tau_n^{(1)}\) and \(\widehat\tau_n^{(2)}\); it does not estimate \(m_i\) or fit a regression.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Theorems 1--2 and Corollary 1 show that zero asymptotic variance for a stationary finite-variance finite-dependent sequence is equivalent to a finite-dependent coboundary and yields an unnormalized endpoint-difference law.
The paper proves consistency and asymptotic normality for exposure-IPW estimators under approximate neighborhood interference and studies network-HAC inference for one randomized finite population.
The paper proves central limit and invariance principles for stationary fields represented as functions of independent innovations under short-range physical dependence.
The paper proves treatment-effect asymptotics under graphon-random interference and develops direct- and indirect-effect inference.

The preprint proves asymptotic normality and optimality for regression-adjusted average-direct-effect estimators under graphon interference and consistently estimates the linear estimator's asymptotic variance under a low-rank graphon condition.

body.tldr: Two independent assignment waves on one buffered F\o lner interval turn the latent Palm population covariance into an observable cross-wave IPW moment. The unchanged sample-mean-centered statistic has uniform finite-sample size and power, with its upper separation bound witnessed by \(\phi_{n,\alpha}\) at order \(n^{-1/2}\), while a lag-\((2r+1)\) cross-wave version is exactly unbiased and has a bias-free bounded-differences threshold of the same order. After fixing the canonical observation as \(W_n\in\mathbb R^{2N_n}\) and allowing only common Borel randomized tests of that vector, an explicit common-support four-point submodel and Le Cam's method prove the matching lower bound. Thus, for fixed \(r,B,\varepsilon,\alpha,\beta\), with \(p=1/2\) and \(\alpha+\beta<1\), the score-vector minimax rate is \(\Theta(n^{-1/2})\).

project_justification.gap: Janson2015 classifies the zero-long-run-variance boundary for finite block factors, while the cited network-interference papers study effect or variance estimation from one randomization. They do not define or solve the two-wave minimax test of whether the Palm population component vanishes.
project_justification.niche: Repeated randomization on the same local network makes cross-wave IPW products conditionally remove assignment noise. A law-independent score-vector experiment then permits a genuine minimax comparison, and a three-type local outcome family keeps the four induced score atoms in common support while moving \(\Omega_{\mathrm{pop}}\) linearly.
project_justification.fill: The project proves the observable cross-wave identity, uniform concentration and finite-sample size--power guarantee for the mean-centered statistic, adds an exactly unbiased lag-separated statistic with a bias-free threshold, and establishes a matching \(\Theta(n^{-1/2})\) minimax separation rate for common Borel tests of the canonical score vector when \(r,B,\varepsilon,\alpha,\beta\) are fixed, \(p=1/2\), and \(\alpha+\beta<1\).

body.related_work: Janson2015 is the primary mathematical comparator: its Theorems 1--2 and Corollary 1 supply the finite-dependent zero-variance, block-factor coboundary, and endpoint-difference laws used to interpret the null, but no two-wave statistical experiment or minimax testing theorem. Leung2022ANI supplies the one-wave exposure-IPW and approximate-neighborhood-interference framework; its finite-population target and network-HAC analysis differ from the present two-wave Palm population-variance diagnostic. AronowSamii2017 supplies exposure mappings and known design propensities, not repeated-wave covariance tests. ElMachkouriVolnyWu2013 informs the iid-innovation representation. LiWager2022 and FanLengWu2025 target causal effects and estimator variances under graphon models rather than the zero boundary of the local Palm covariance component. The matching converse here instead uses Tsybakov2009's Pinsker and two-point inequalities on an explicitly constructed four-atom induced score law; common support refers only to those induced score laws.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The design requires two conditionally independent assignment waves applied to the same no-carryover potential-outcome schedule. The single-wave BondEtAl2012 experiment cannot be reanalyzed with this diagnostic. The finite-radius restriction and ambient interval lags are deliberate: no approximate-neighborhood-interference transfer, random-radius stabilization, graph-distance HAC consistency, or unchanged graph-HAC exactness is asserted. The minimax lower bound is a score-law result and does not cover a richer raw-data observation experiment.
body.honest_scope: The causal target remains \(\Omega_{\mathrm{pop}}\), the long-run variance of fixed local conditional exposure-effect scores under the Palm population law. The mean-centered diagnostic, exact-unbiased auxiliary statistic, and their uniform size--power guarantees hold over the declared two-wave finite-range class. Minimax sharpness is proved only for the canonical experiment whose observation is \(W_n\) and whose tests are common Borel maps \(\mathbb R^{2N_n}\to[0,1]\), with the displayed lower bound specialized to \(p=1/2\) and \(\alpha+\beta<1\). Richer tests using the innovations, graph, assignments, exposures, or outcomes beyond the scores are outside the converse.
